name: page-turn
summary: A book page: half of the current picture turns over in perspective, its back is the next picture's other half, the uncovered half lies under a shade that lifts. The turn itself is the cut.
use: st = state(params, u) for u 0 → 1 over the turn; canvas(ctx, st, A, B, params) with A and B the two pictures as full-frame canvases (lib/paint.js offscreen()). leaf() and drawLeaf() are the geometry and its drawing, for other folds.

slots.name: ease
slots.text: how the turn runs over u: a lib/core.js ease name, a CSS curve or [x1, y1, x2, y2]

slots.name: backward
slots.text: turn the left half over to the right (paging back)

slots.name: slices
slots.text: vertical slices the leaf is drawn in; fewer show as facets

slots.name: perspective
slots.text: the viewer's distance; smaller bends the leaf more

slots.name: dark
slots.text: the leaf's shade when it stands edge-on

slots.name: under
slots.text: the shade on the uncovered half at the start, lifting as the turn ends

sample.text: the contact sheet's moments: the middle of each seam

provenance.note: canvas-film's turn transition and its leaf, made engine-free
